snippet.title: Fox Flare Night - Steam Next Fest: October 2025 Demo
snippet.description:
Shape-shifting Kitsune Mio battles the mischievous Tanuki army in this fast-paced, comedic side-scrolling shooter! Unleash powerful yōjutsu and transformations to dodge bullet barrages. Packed with modes for both casual and hardcore players, offering plenty of content to master!

Developed by Outside / あうとさいど
Release Date: TBD
